ضلوا (form I)
# ضَلُّوا (ḍallū) /dˤal.luː/: third-person masculine plural past active of ضَلَّ (ḍalla)
# ضُلُّوا (ḍullū) /dˤul.luː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of ضَلَّ (ḍalla)
# ضِلُّوا (ḍillū) /dˤil.luː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of ضَلَّ (ḍalla)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
